Inspect the CURRENT screen state and decide whether this task was actually completed successfully: Pass when the exact target in {name} visibly confirms that a new OTP was requested or sent, or shows a target-owned OTP input form. Judge the full current screen, not only enumerated clickable elements; a browser overlay does not invalidate success when the target-owned OTP form remains visibly identifiable behind it. An ordinary credential form, a matching destination URL alone, browser chrome without identifiable target-owned OTP content, a new-tab page, an unrelated page, or a prompt that fully obscures the target state is incomplete and must not pass.. Report your verdict as structured output.
